name: home-assistant-tapboard

scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts public test eslint.config.js --fix

scripts.lint: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.lint:check: eslint src scripts public test eslint.config.js --max-warnings=0 && npm run format:check
